question: Please provide the top 10 tree species in New York, using their uppercase Latin names where the Latin name is not empty and including their common names, showing the total number of trees, the counts of alive and dead trees for each year, and the corresponding growth in these counts from 1995 to 2015, then order by the difference in total tree counts between these years.
sql:
WITH c1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin_upper,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(spc_latin), r"\s+(VAR\.|X|'[^']*')(.*)", '') AS base_latin,
    ARRAY_AGG(spc_common ORDER BY spc_common LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS spc_common,
    SUM(1) AS total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Fair', 'Critical', 'Poor') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(spc_latin) != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(spc_latin), r"\s+(VAR\.|X|'[^']*')(.*)", '')
),
c2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin_upper,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(spc_latin), r"\s+(VAR\.|X|'[^']*')(.*)", '') AS base_latin,
    ARRAY_AGG(spc_common ORDER BY spc_common LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS spc_common,
    SUM(1) AS total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(spc_latin) != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(spc_latin), r"\s+(VAR\.|X|'[^']*')(.*)", '')
),
agg1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    base_latin,
    ARRAY_AGG(spc_common ORDER BY spc_common LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS spc_common,
    SUM(total_count) AS total_count,
    SUM(alive_count) AS alive_count,
    SUM(dead_count) AS dead_count
  FROM c1995
  GROUP BY base_latin
),
agg2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    base_latin,
    ARRAY_AGG(spc_common ORDER BY spc_common LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS spc_common,
    SUM(total_count) AS total_count,
    SUM(alive_count) AS alive_count,
    SUM(dead_count) AS dead_count
  FROM c2015
  GROUP BY base_latin
)
SELECT 
  a.base_latin AS spc_latin_upper,
  COALESCE(b.spc_common, a.spc_common) AS spc_common,
  a.total_count AS total_1995,
  b.total_count AS total_2015,
  a.alive_count AS alive_1995,
  b.alive_count AS alive_2015,
  a.dead_count AS dead_1995,
  b.dead_count AS dead_2015,
  b.total_count - a.total_count AS growth_total,
  b.alive_count - a.alive_count AS growth_alive,
  b.dead_count - a.dead_count AS growth_dead
FROM agg1995 a
INNER JOIN agg2015 b ON a.base_latin = b.base_latin
ORDER BY growth_total DESC
LIMIT 10
